statusHistory.note: Batch 2026-09-07-batch-30, article 2/30: researched English draft. Operator directive mid-run: look well beyond Time Out as a standing rule — sourced from SLOP Magazine, Hot Dinners, The Nudge and official channels alongside Time Out. Google Maps confirmed current, open, LGBTQ+-friendly-tagged, 4.8/844 reviews (recent reviews read, mostly positive). r/LondonFood thread read directly via claude-in-chrome (Reddit blocks the fetch backend; browser escalation worked) — genuine mixed testimony quoted, including a real negative (underwhelmed by the yuzu Jaffa cake, underbaked chocolatine). Name-change-from-Frog-Bakery detail sourced independently. Second Deptford site (opened 8 July 2026) verified via Hot Dinners and Instagram, mentioned as expansion context, not a separate pin. Pending: hero image resolution, five locale editions, full sign-offs, publish gates.

Batch 2026-09-07-batch-30: hero resolved (tier 1, real photo from the bakery's own site, dated asset Nov 2025). Coordinator sign-off pass (near-tov-police/language-tic-police/near-legal-counsel/chief-editor lenses): no opening-line bans, headline avoids the bare-name and 'The ___ that' formulas, no process-as-copy (queue/hype framed as reader-facing, not backlog language), no rank-pulling. Legal: the negative UGC quote (raw chocolatine, gelatinous topping) is attributed to a named platform/thread and dated, not stated as fact, and carries no defamation-adjacent business allegation. Link-density passes (SLOP/Hot Dinners/Nudge/Reddit in-text, one internal NearLink to Borough Market). Red team: no price claims made (menu prices not independently verified this session, correctly omitted rather than guessed); Deptford opening date sourced and dated; no internal jargon leaked. Discover audit: hero clears spec, headline doesn't over-promise past the body. Revenue pass: no natural affiliate/ad-sales opportunity for a walk-in bakery; logged none. Five locale editions written (pt-BR, it, es-ES, es-419, zh-CN), each a genuine local edition at/above the 150-word floor, each with its own publishNote.
